issue.title: Battery telemetry raw current values
issue.body:
Hi,

In the current version 1.3.1 [battery telemetry](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/66b7b2e4736c884f3c530ec42376b10c80de857d/src/mavsdk/plugins/telemetry/telemetry_impl.cpp#L1151) only contains battery id, voltage and remaining capacity percentage.

Is there a way to get the raw current readings, too, as the MAVLINK battery message does contain it, and if not can it be included in later versions of MAVSDK?

Thanks in advance.

comments.body:
It is defined [here](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Proto/blob/main/protos/telemetry/telemetry.proto#L567-L572). I think you could try to add it to the proto file, generate the code and implement it in `telemetry_impl.cpp` (that you pointed above).

If you open a PR with that, we'll be happy to review and help :blush:

issue.title: telemetry: add energy_consumed_wh to Battery

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
## Summary

Fixes #1748 — exposes the `energy_consumed` field from the MAVLink `BATTERY_STATUS` message which was previously ignored.

### Changes

- **C++ (`telemetry.hpp`)**: Added `energy_consumed_wh` field to `Battery` struct
- **C++ (`telemetry.cpp`)**: Updated `operator==` and `operator<<` for `Battery`
- **C++ (`telemetry_impl.cpp`)**: Populated `energy_consumed_wh` in `process_battery_status()` — converts from hectojoules (hJ, the MAVLink unit) to Watt-hours: `energy_consumed / 36.0f` (1 hJ = 100 J, 1 Wh = 3600 J). Sentinel value −1 (not available) maps to `NaN`.
- **C binding (`telemetry.h`, `telemetry.cpp`)**: Added field to `mavsdk_telemetry_battery_t` and translation functions
- **Python binding (`telemetry.py`)**: Added field to `BatteryCStruct`, `Battery.__init__`, `Battery.from_c_struct`, `Battery.to_c_struct`, and `Battery.__str__`

### Notes

The proto definition (`telemetry.proto`) has a companion PR in [MAVSDK-Proto](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Proto) adding `float energy_consumed_wh = 9` to the `Battery` message. The `.pb.h`/`.pb.cc` generated files need to be regenerated once that proto PR merges (requires protoc 29.1).

issue.title: telemetry: add energy_consumed_wh to Battery

repository.name: MAVSDK-Proto
repository.description: Collection of proto files used by gRPC in MAVSDK

issue.body:
## Summary

Adds `energy_consumed_wh` as field 9 to the `Battery` message in `telemetry.proto`.

This exposes the `energy_consumed` field from the MAVLink `BATTERY_STATUS` message. The implementation in MAVSDK converts from hectojoules (hJ, the MAVLink unit) to Watt-hours by dividing by 36. The sentinel value −1 (field not available) maps to `NaN`.

**Companion PR:** mavlink/MAVSDK#2882

Fixes https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/issues/1748

issue.title: Revert "telemetry: add energy_consumed_wh to Battery (#2882)"

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Reverts #2882.

The `energy_consumed_wh` field does not address the original issue (#1748), which asked for current readings (`current_battery_a` — already present in the API). Reverting to avoid confusion.
